TI Windows tooling archived for locked-board recovery over the ICDI probe.
LMFlashProgrammer_1613.zip           - LM Flash Programmer (has --debug-unlock)
stellaris_icdi_drivers_spmc016a.zip  - Stellaris ICDI USB drivers (WinUSB-based)
Both are export-gated downloads from ti.com; kept here so recovery does not
depend on re-fetching them. macOS/Wine cannot drive the ICDI; use a Windows host.
